integrity: The cited low-dimensional classification was inspected at the exact Trias_2^33 table. The endomorphism conditions, eleven trialgebra identities, Hom-twisted identities, and downstream admissible brackets were reconstructed directly. Finite-field enumeration is supplementary replay evidence.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns Examples 4.9 and 4.22, not the general twisting and admissibility theorems.
The 2025 journal full text was not publicly retrievable for direct same-example comparison.
The finite-field count extends the corrected polynomial table beyond the primary source's characteristic-zero convention.
title: Repairing the two-dimensional trialgebra twist in Examples 4.9 and 4.22
